svg.aria-label: The full mode, detailed view. Boxes: academic-paper 3.2.0: Phase 0 Intake: configuration record, citation verification: mark only or strict (stop); you skip Phase 1, giving your own sources? (question); Phase 1 Literature strategist: screens your sources, searches for what they miss, unless you say your sources only (agent); You review the sources: add or remove, optional (stop); Phase 2 Structure architect: outline and evidence map (agent); Outline approval (stop); Phase 3 Argument builder (agent); Phase 4 Draft writer: 4a pre-commitment, 4b draft and self-scores (agent); Visualization, when there are quantitative results: figure code and LaTeX inclusion code (agent); Phase aborted: you decide (stop); Phase 5a Citation compliance: corrects format and DOIs, flags a wrong source, stops on a claim not in its source (agent); Phase 5b Abstract agent, in parallel (agent); Phase 6 Peer reviewer, round 1: 6a scoring plan, 6b scores and verdict (agent); You decide (stop); Draft writer: revises, a full draft again (agent); Peer reviewer, round 2: the revised sections (agent); RAISE compliance check, warnings only (agent); Phase 7 Formatter: adds the AI disclosure and limitations if missing, places the figures, converts, compiles with tectonic or xelatex (agent); Final checklist: content, format, required elements, DOIs; compile errors fixed, warnings accepted (agent); Hard gate: a citation unverified, fabricated or unsupported, or blocked under strict? (question); Output refused: you fix it (stop); Output package (agent) | paper, as ruled: Intake: config.md, the interview [D24]; skip the search? DOI checking [O], venue policy [W], claims not to make [AI2], main.tex to replace [AD4], a file in words [AQ], research report, question, type [AV1, AV3, AV15] (stop); you skip the search? [J] (ruled); Session: the search themes, one per research community, each with its strands and range, in config.md Decisions [The theme search] (question); Literature strategist, theme run: search theme 1, its own theme-1/ folder, review-theme-1.md and refs-theme-1.bib [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, theme runs: each other search theme, all at once, each in its own folder [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist, merge run, fresh: one entry per work, the criteria again, the cut sources, chaining from the theme runs' core papers, each pair of search themes, the gates; one review.md, refs.bib [The theme search] (ruled, only when needed); Literature strategist: screens your sources, searches for what they miss; a list over 50 entries shows its first 20 and last 5 [J, AV16] (ruled, only when needed); Each entry confirmed against an index with resolve --entry: corrected once, else left out of refs.bib and named [BI] (ruled); You review the sources: add or remove, optional [J]; after theme runs, each search theme with its count [The theme search] (stop); Planner: outline and evidence map, argument map; one role for structure architect and argument builder [D43]; the structure checked against the question and the materials [AV18] (ruled); A research question the materials do not answer: the part, the files and lines, what would answer it, three options [BI] (stop); Literature strategist, resumed or fresh: the sections that need literature and have no source [AD1, BR]; the merge run's after theme runs [The theme search] (ruled); Planner again: assigns what was found [AD1] (ruled); Planner, fresh: rewrites each argument with two or more weak-argument signs [The simulation in step 5.F] (ruled); Outline approval: each rewritten argument before and after [The simulation in step 5.F] (stop); Planner: asks what is wrong with the structure, writes 2 alternatives; your own structure is followed as user-customized [AD2] (ruled); Draft writer: first draft, abstract in the venue's form, six statements, figure places [S], model named [N], claims list and results [AV7, BH], cover letter [AV8], no self-scores [D43, D45], prose standard [AJ, AW] (ruled); Draft writer once more: the model identifier, when the list gave none [N] or the served one differs (ruled); Visualization, when the materials hold data, beside the writer [D43]: figures and their LaTeX, placed as its own patch [S] (ruled); Script: cite-keys, check-urls [AF] (script); Citation compliance agent, after the draft and before round 1: reads each cited source, judges every claim, checks the claims not to make and the intended claims [AF, AI2, AV7, The simulation in step 5.F] (ruled); A claim the run cannot support: every claim not held in one list, a source not read apart [AF, The simulation in step 5.F] (stop); The citation style to confirm: more than half the entries fail the same check [AV14] (stop); Script: cite-keys, check-urls, quote-check [AF] (script); Citation compliance agent again, fresh, once [AF] (ruled); Peer reviewer, round 1: fixed criteria, no scoring plan, reads the citation report [D45, AF] (ruled); The draft review does not pass, no answer recommended: the root cause and its estimate; revise by hand, a lower venue, accept, an expanded revision by root cause, or end [AD3, BR] (stop); The draft review rejects the draft: each Critical issue fixable, structural or fundamental, a roadmap; nothing revised before you confirm [BR] (stop); Draft writer: round 1 issues, a patch [C] (ruled); Citation compliance agent, fresh: the cited sentences of the patch only, citation-report-<nn>.md [BI] (ruled); Peer reviewer, round 2: also checks each number against its result file and row, and each description of the data handling [D45, BH] (ruled); Script: reference checks (script); Draft writer: reference-fix, once [K] (ruled); Script: reference checks again, failures left named [K] (script); A reference that cannot be confirmed [O] (stop); Session: compile in a copy, no formatter; the engine is the first that applies of a % !TEX program line, the class table, the venue's template, XeLaTeX [M, AV11] [4.A R2-6] (ruled); Session: the PDF of the compile copied to main.pdf beside main.tex [The simulation in step 5.F] (ruled); Draft writer: compile-fix, once [M] (ruled); Session: compile once more, the rest named [M] (ruled); /writing review: 4 agents, unless you said no at intake [D46, 5.C (2)] (ruled, only when needed); End: the final message with the numbered report, the sources only a preprint server or no index matched, and a verdict that was not Accept [D46, AG] (ruled); Draft writer: applies the findings [D46] (ruled); Citation compliance agent, fresh: the cited sentences of the findings pass [BI] (ruled); Peer reviewer, fresh: reads the findings pass, its numbers and its descriptions of the data; an item goes to the writer once, then the compile [BI] (ruled); Draft writer: the anonymous copy, when the venue is double-blind [AV9] (ruled); Formatter: the DOCX and Markdown targets of Target formats, after the last compile [The simulation in step 5.F] (ruled, only when needed); At every patch: a structural patch, a patch that does not apply (retry as often as you ask, write it again in full, or leave it [BR]), a script failed [C] (stop); At every agent start: a model other than the configured one [D47] (stop).
